headline: Auto Momentum Offsets Farm Weakness; Earnings Ahead of Estimates

highlights: Key Points  Strong Earnings Beat; Sequential Margin Recovery: M&M reported 2QFY27 standalone revenue of Rs442.8bn (+26.2% YoY/+5.5% QoQ), 5.6%/7.6% ahead of NBIE/consensus estimates.

EBITDA rose 4.4% YoY/31.2% QoQ to Rs67.5bn, beating NBIE/consensus by 36.5%/34.9%, with EBITDA margin at 15.3% (-318bps YoY/+298bps QoQ), also aided by higher income from investments during the quarter.
PAT grew 12.9% YoY/38.4% QoQ to Rs51.0bn, 39.9%/13.3% ahead of NBIE/consensus.
Core tractor margins are expected to remain under pressure in 3QFY27, improve in 4QFY27, and normalise in FY28.
valuation: Commodity inflation persists, though easing precious metal and crude prices should help.  Valuation: We reiterate BUY with an SOTP-based TP of Rs4,440 (previous TP: Rs4,381), valuing the core business at 20x Sep-28E core EPS.

CMP: Rs3,128 | Target Price (TP): Rs4,440 | Upside: 42% November 06, 2026 Institutional Equities Mahindra & Mahindra 2 Group businesses drive 25% growth in consolidated PAT: Consolidated revenue rose 25% YoY to Rs575.5bn and PAT grew 25% to Rs45.9bn.
Management reiterated its 15-20% EPS growth and 18% RoE targets (1HFY27 annualised RoE: 21%).

Tractor outlook cut; LCVs and LMM remain capacity-constrained: Tractor volumes declined 6% YoY to 116,000 units in 2QFY27 (1HFY27: +7%), with market share at 41.5% (-150bps YoY; 1HFY27: 43.4%), as the festive season shifted into 3QFY27.
